summary: M12 GREEN: registerRlmPlugin lazily attaches the official "rlm" job controller (`ctx.jobs.attachController("rlm")`, detached on unload) and exports createRlmJobSpec(parent, code, runtime) which runs one cell through the same runtime as an official DSH job (kind rlm, bounded output, cancel maps to kernel dispose, kill settles killed). No second Agent loop, scheduler, queue, Workflow, Storage, or UI markup.

pointers: M12 Issue#48: registerRlmPlugin attaches the rlm job controller
createRlmJobSpec runs one cell and reports bounded output
a job kill settles as killed and disposes the kernel

steps: Read the official dsh-jobs contract: JobStart/JobHooks/attachController semantics and the tool-jobs attachment pattern.
Added lazy attachController("rlm") in registerRlmPlugin and exported createRlmJobSpec wrapping runtime.eval with cancel->dispose and bounded readOutput.
Ran typecheck + focused M12 tests 3/3 + full suite (195 pass / 11 live-gated skips / 0 fail), build clean.

evidence.note: 3/3: controller attach, job run + bounded output, kill -> killed.
